metadata.title: Central and Lp-concentration of 1-Lipschitz maps into R-trees
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the Le ´vy-Milman concentration phenomenon of 1-Lipschitz maps from mm-spaces to R-trees. Our main theorems assert that the concentration to R-trees is equivalent to the concentration to the real line.
